messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INVESTIGATE: p99 latency spike on /v1/generate observed across multiple regions. Current p95=420ms p99=2.3s. Paging oncall.

maya: saw alerts in eu-west first, then us-west. Streaming stalls reported by a couple customers.

nate: seeing a lot of 504s from downstream: 
```
upstream request timeout to control-plane: auth/token fetch exceeded 1.5s
```

luca_sre: tail traces show a long wait on DB connection acquire and repeated retries for feature flag checks. p99 of feature-flag-get is ~1.7s.

maya: tagging db-pager. @db-pager can you confirm DB health/locks?

db-pager: looking now, queries queued on auth.tokens table. write spikes + many short-lived transactions. CPU on primary db at 85%. No full OOM.

alice_prod: customer-facing: one enterprise customer reported streaming stalls after 10s of streaming tokens. They saw repeated reconnects.

oncall: I'm taking this incident. quick mitigation plan: 1) enable feature-flag cache fallback 2) increase token service rate limit temporarily 3) failover read-only replicas for flag reads.

nate: I can push a canary config for feature-flag cache TTL to 30s for inference path only. Will do via console.

maya: +1. Add a circuit-breaker on feature flag queries to avoid blocking the request path. We have a flag that can serve defaults.

luca_sre: quick datapoints: control-plane auth latency timeline: 1769123380 p50=60ms p95=420ms p99=2300ms. Token DB queue length jumped at 1769123365.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042. Severity: Sev2. Affected: hosted API streaming + dedicated pools in eu-west/us-west.

oncall: @nate push the TTL canary then fallback policy. @alice_prod start customer comms: note degraded streaming, we're investigating cause and mitigations.

nate: pushing canary now -> console deploy: 
```
PATCH /config/flags/deployment
payload: {"feature_flag_cache_ttl": 30, "scope": "inference-path"}
```

nate: deployed canary to 10% of traffic at 1769123512. Monitoring auth latencies.

luca_sre: auth p99 dropped to 900ms for canary traffic. Non-canary still at ~2.1s. Queue length decreased slightly.

db-pager: we see reduced contention on auth.tokens for replica reads. Primary still has some write backlog. Investigating source of writes.

alice_prod: sent initial customer note to impacted accounts at 1769123550: "We're seeing elevated streaming latency; temporary mitigation in progress."

oncall: next step: disable non-critical feature flags that fan-out DB reads on token refresh. @luca_sre can you list top offenders?

luca_sre: top offenders: feature X (entitlement checks), feature Y (region-affinity lookup), feature Z (experiment assignment). X and Y together cause ~40% of extra reads.

nate: disabling feature Y for inference route now. command: 
```
POST /admin/flags/disable
body: {"flag": "feature_y", "scope": "/v1/generate"}
```

nate: disabled at 1769123598. Observability: auth p95 improved to 210ms, p99 to 650ms. Queue length returned to baseline.

db-pager: primary write rate decreased after disable. CPU trending down to 60%. No further replication lag alerts.

maya: customer reports indicate streaming is recovering for some users. Still a handful of residual stalls in earlier sessions.

oncall: we're going to keep canary and feature Y disabled for 30 minutes, then gradually roll back if stable. Also scheduling handoff to night oncall in 40 minutes.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: oncall shift change at 1769127000. Current incident INC-2026-042 active.

alice_prod: prepping post-incident summary and customer follow-up. Will include timeline and actions.

nate: started a quick runbook entry for this class: add autoscaling threshold for DB token table, add local in-memory TTL cache on inference nodes for feature flags.

luca_sre: opened ticket TICK-987 to add circuit-breaker to flag client - low-effort, high ROI.

db-pager: marking incident as mitigated for DB queueing. Will keep monitoring for 1 hour.

maya: any residual perf anomalies?

oncall: p95 now ~180ms p99 ~600ms, streaming errors down to baseline. Marking as partial-resolved; leaving incident open until end of postmortem.

alice_prod: noted impacted customers list and who to follow up with.

nate: followups: (1) implement in-memory TTL cache on inference runtime (2) add flag client circuit-breaker (3) improve alerting to include DB queue length and feature-flag latency correlated dashboards.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring.

oncall: handing off to night oncall @luca_sre in 30m. Leaving instructions in incident doc. :thumbsup:

luca_sre: taking ownership at 1769123710. Will watch for regressions and coordinate postmortem.
